# Official AIUI reference snapshot

Source: https://github.com/yodaos-project/AIUI

Current revision: 23ef1821f8db4b7212d361a6a1196558efee024f

Upstream project declares Apache-2.0. Original author notices and file contents are retained. Each snapshot includes official documentation and the available public AIUI skills, with references and starter assets. The previous snapshot remains available for projects pinned to it.

The live updater verifies each downloaded file against its Git blob hash, then atomically activates a complete snapshot.
